_comment: Per-site settings for framework/cli/site_consistency_audit.py. The storage copy at config/site-consistency-audit-config.json is laid over this repo default (dicts merge key by key, lists replace), then an explicit --config file. A site block is chosen by the --base host (www. ignored). request_headers go on every page request to that site (a probe header marks the audit's traffic as self-traffic); never_fetch_path_re lists paths never requested (affiliate click-outs log a click). article_audit = the recent-article audit (2026-11-12 article review): every article published in the last window_days is fetched and checked even when the crawl never reached it. Source: a read-only SELECT (dsn_env + query with %(days)s / %(limit)s, returning slug and optionally title, category, bucket, hero_image_url, published_at; url_template builds the URL from {slug}) or the sitemap (sitemap_path_re + <lastmod>); source auto = db when the DSN env is set, else the sitemap. Checks and knobs: raw-markdown (visible text of the article region, code excluded); small-hero (og:image, else the DB hero, under hero_min_width px or hero_min_bytes); hero-offsite-host (hero host not in allowed_image_hosts, suffix match; empty list = off); duplicate-hero (same hero URL after image_url_normalize, or same bytes, on >= duplicate_hero_min recent articles); heavy-image (any article image over max_image_bytes or max_image_width px); no-buy-link-on-monetized-article (monetized = category/bucket in monetized_buckets, title matching monetized_title_re, or >= monetized_min_product_links links matching product_link_re; buy links match buy_link_re, tested against the path of an own-host link and the full URL of any other, with and without the query; keep monetized_title_re and product_link_re in step with min_buy_links_by_title and product_page_patterns in config/article-link-guard-config.json, so the audit never reports what the guard never asked the author for); recent-article-noindex; recent-article-redirects; article-audit-unavailable; hidden-article-body (the article region, or an element around it, carries display:none / visibility:hidden / the hidden attribute / aria-hidden=true, or sits in <noscript>/<template>: a renderer with JS on sees no article; hidden_body_ok = true silences it for a site that means it); shared-link-set (at least shared_link_set_min links matching shared_link_re, the same ones, on two or more recent articles: a site-wide fallback module standing in for each article's own cards; empty shared_link_re = off). severity = {kind: error|warn|info}. Defaults live in ARTICLE_DEFAULTS in the CLI.

article_audit.query: SELECT slug, title, category, bucket, hero_image_url, COALESCE(published_at, created_at) AS published_at FROM editorial_articles WHERE status = 'published' AND COALESCE(published_at, created_at) > now() - make_interval(days => %(days)s) ORDER BY COALESCE(published_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT %(limit)s
